title: Haunted Manor Light Restoration
description: The user stands inside a dark haunted manor with a broken stained-glass window and several hurricane candle holders scattered around the room. They must pick up, position, and ignite candle holders near the broken window to restore spectral light beams that pass through the shards, while managing a finite light energy budget that is conserved across all candles. Full undo/redo support lets them experiment with placements.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a haunted manor light restoration puzzle. Load GlassBrokenWindow.glb and place it as a large wall-mounted broken window at one end of a dark room built from simple box geometry (floor, walls, ceiling with dark stone-like MeshStandardMaterial). Load GlassHurricaneCandleHolder.glb and clone it 5 times, placing holders at random positions on the floor. Use a dim ambient light (intensity 0.05) and no other initial lights. Camera: PerspectiveCamera at room center with OrbitControls, constrained inside the room. Interactions (10-14 steps): 1) Click a candle holder to select it (outline via emissive highlight). 2) Drag selected holder to reposition on the floor plane via raycasting. 3) Press 'I' to ignite the selected holder, adding a PointLight child (warm orange, range 5). 4) Press 'E' to extinguish it, removing the light. 5) A global 'Light Energy' budget of 100 units is displayed in an HTML overlay HUD. Each ignited candle consumes 20 energy. Energy is conserved: extinguishing returns energy. Cannot ignite if insufficient energy. 6) Press 'B' to boost a lit candle (costs extra 10 energy, doubles intensity). 7) Press 'D' to dim it back (returns 10 energy). 8) When a lit candle is within distance 3 of the broken window, cast a colored SpotLight through the window outward using the candle position as origin, simulating spectral refraction. Tint the spotlight with a hue derived from candle index. 9) Display a 'Restoration Score' (0-100%) based on how many distinct spectral beams are active. 10) Full undo/redo stack: pressing Ctrl+Z undoes the last action (move, ignite, extinguish, boost, dim) restoring previous state including positions, light states, and energy. Ctrl+Y redoes. Store action history as an array of state snapshots. Show energy bar and score in a top-left HUD div. Add a subtle fog (FogExp2) for atmosphere.
